title: Read a full interview record
preconditions: The local app is running with the seeded database.
An approved institutional session is available and stored for reuse.

steps.action: Open a known record while signed in.
steps.expected: The company, role, outcome, candidate details, and round list render, with the record id visible.
The round detail opens with its questions and closes back to the list.
The original candidate text renders in the document reader.

steps.action: Open a record id that does not exist.
steps.expected: The not-found page renders instead of an error or a blank screen.

risk: Read-only, but requires an identity this run does not have. Report blocked rather than substituting the public API response.
